newsitem.title: CHINA: China firecracker factory blast kills six.
newsitem.headline: China firecracker factory blast kills six.

text.p: An explosion at an illegal firecracker factory in southwestern China earlier this month killed six people and injured 13, the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.
The blast at the private plant in Hepu county in southwestern Guangxi province killed factory workers and the owner's wife and children and destroyed three buildings, Xinhua said.
It said the explosion was caused by a cooking fire that set alight firecrackers produced at the factory, which had not been approved by county authorities.
Local officials contacted by telephone declined to give further details of the blast.
